ops.body: Fixed by the v0.21.0 cut. Gate spot-checked: Label.element delegates to launchd.ValidateLabel (daemon.go:49-53), whose canonical rule (launchd/agent.go:306-318) rejects empty labels, anything where filepath.Base differs (path separators), leading/trailing dots, any '..', and characters outside [A-Za-z0-9.-] — ../../evil cannot pass. Root Open validates before retaining the daemon (client.go:17-22), and Serve/deploy.Open validate before deriving operational paths. Residual (raw Daemon.RecordPath on an unvalidated standalone Daemon) stays a documented boundary contract per the lane's note.
